# Belinda & Harcourt

- [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) — Friend of — [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md) — close friends residing in the same household · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) during a meal, sharing stories about [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md). Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) walk to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), where they share food, enjoy the echoes, and go off to pick early strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P7](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0007), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P37](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0037)_

> While picking strawberries for tea, [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) expresses concern to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over Miss Rosalind's lingering melancholic mood and failing health. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resolves to stay at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) during her vacation to help lift Miss Rosalind's spirits. Afterwards, the group enjoys tea outside, and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) sits with Miss Rosalind as she opens up to him about her imaginary dream-boy.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes a letter to [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and sends it via the post office. Later that evening, [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) arrives at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) to see [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md). To the delight of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) and [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) walk into the garden together, embracing as lovers.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P71](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0071)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepares for Rosalind's wedding while discussing the romantic developments with [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stumbles upon Isolde and [Gideon](../character/gideon-duckett.md) sharing an intimate moment in the garden, confirming their secret love. Isolde then visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to confide her engagement, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to reflect on love and her own romantic ideals.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends assist with the preparations for [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) Penrose's wedding at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage). The ceremony takes place in the garden as the sun breaks through the overcast sky, after which the guests see the newlyweds off at the train station. Left alone after tidying up, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) waits for Hugh and experiences a subtle shift in her feelings toward him.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P33](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0033), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P40](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0040)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends a delightful summer in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), missing Hugh despite denying her feelings. She catches up with returning friends including [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), while [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) realizes he is growing out of his childhood fairyland fantasies. During a visit to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), Miss Rosalind gently presses [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on why she will not marry Hugh.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Cedric Cannot Find the Rock People

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P11](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0011), [v3 ch.People P15](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0015), [v3 ch.People P22](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0022)_
